selected_problem: Fresh canonical main verified staged postimage bytes before apply, but rollback still decoded before.contentBase64 and restored it without first proving that those persisted bytes matched before.sha256/before.size. A corrupted durable rollback payload could therefore restore bytes different from the transactional preimage that the changeset claimed to preserve, even while the current workspace correctly matched the applied postimage.
decision_basis: The North Star execution-kernel contract already defines before.sha256 and before.contentBase64 as the transactional preimage, so verifying their self-consistency closes an existing reversible-delivery invariant rather than choosing a new architecture.
Preimage verification is moved into rollback preflight before any restore mutation, and the exact verified bytes are then reused for restoration.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.source_observation: Fresh main rollback checked that the live workspace still equaled the expected applied postimage, but restored decode(c.before.contentBase64) directly and only checked before.type inside the later mutation loop.
pre_fix_reality.impact: persisted rollback preimage bytes could diverge from before.sha256/before.size and still become the restored workspace content

change: Rollback now validates the staged preimage in preflight. Existing-file preimages must be file-typed and their decoded bytes must match the recorded size and SHA-256; absent preimages must retain null/zero metadata. The exact verified bytes are carried into the mutation phase, so malformed preimage metadata fails closed before any file is restored.

validation.focused_preimage_replay: PASS: corrupted persisted before.contentBase64 is rejected with CHANGESET_PREIMAGE_CORRUPT while an intact preimage materializes the exact original bytes
validation.branch_source_reinspection: PASS: stagedBeforeBytes is executed during rollback preflight and verified beforeBytes are reused during restoration

truth_boundary: This verifies rollback preimage self-consistency against its recorded hash/size/type before restoration. It is not an authenticated runtime-artifact signature or trust root and does not claim protection against coherent malicious rewrites of all persisted metadata.
